title: At 6, he moved his first chess piece. By 12, he was ranked 7th in America for his age.
caption:
At 6, he moved his first chess piece. By 12, he was ranked 7th in America for his age.

He quit a big New York law firm after 7 months and 3 days. Then he lost out on a Supreme Court clerkship.

So he moved to California, co-founded PayPal, and became Facebook's first outside investor: $500,000 for 10.2%.

That kid is Peter Thiel. Forbes puts his net worth at over $37 billion.

What rejection turned out to be your luckiest break?
